data.narrative:
Impulse Labs is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company in the Climate & Energy sector. The valuation universe comprises 1 public comparable (Linzatech, ticker LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage companies with comparable valuation tiers to support a robust peer-median multiple approach—no narrow peer cohort of 3 or more firms met filtering criteria.

Given data constraints, the stage-progression method is the primary applicable framework. Using total capital raised of $25M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $50M. This method captures the expectation of value creation between financing rounds in the frontier-energy space, though it does not incorporate company-specific operational or market metrics.

The triangulated range is $42M to $57M, centered on a $50M median. This range reflects the single applicable method, with the bounds capturing inherent uncertainty in stage-progression multipliers for early-stage climate tech. Key limitations include absence of granular peer multiples and lack of disclosed revenue, unit economics, or technology maturity data. Validation of a post-money valuation within this range would benefit from comparison to disclosed Series A terms for Climate & Energy peers as additional data becomes available.
